products.name: Spytec Pulse OBD Plug-In GPS Tracker (hardware free with plan)
specs: $8.95/month on the annual plan ($107.40/year) or $14.95/month month to month
Every 2 seconds while moving, every 3 hours parked (default)
Instant alert if the device is unplugged
Plugs into the OBD-II port, 8-32 V DC
US, Canada, Mexico and worldwide (Super SIM)
Automatic: 5% at 5-9 vehicles up to 25% at 100+
products.warranty: Lifetime device warranty while the subscription is active (TrackerCare, per the store page).
products.returns: 30-day money-back guarantee with a prepaid return label. No termination fee, and you can cancel any month.
products.summary: A plug-in OBD-II tracker that comes free with a Spytec plan. It reports every 2 seconds while the vehicle moves and alerts you right away if it is unplugged.
products.fit: Small businesses tracking several vans or trucks, and anyone willing to pay a year at a time for the lowest Spytec rate.
caveats: A subscription is required. Month-to-month costs $14.95, against $8.95 on the annual plan.
Spytec does not advertise crash alerts or check-engine code reading.
It sits in the OBD port under the dash, so a driver can see it and unplug it.
Billing and cancellation are frequent themes in owner reviews. Get written confirmation when you cancel.

products.name: Spytec Pulse Hardwired Vehicle GPS Tracker (hardware free with plan)
specs: $12.95/month on the annual plan ($155.40/year) or $14.95/month month to month
Wired to vehicle power and hidden out of sight
products.warranty: Lifetime device warranty while the subscription is active (per the store page).
products.returns: 30-day money-back guarantee with a prepaid return label. No termination fee.
products.summary: A hidden, hardwired version of Spytec's vehicle tracker for anyone who doesn't want a device a driver or thief can see in the OBD port.
products.fit: Theft recovery, work trucks, and older vehicles or equipment with no OBD port.
caveats: It has to be wired into the vehicle's power, which is more work than plugging into the OBD port.
The annual plan costs more than the OBD version ($12.95 against $8.95 a month).
The store page doesn't state an update interval.
